title: Add admin-only daily updates for marks, test subjects, and attendance

requirements.summary: Enhance the marks recording interface to support daily updates by admin users with test subject selection and update capability
acceptanceCriteria: Admin users see a dropdown to select from available test subjects when recording marks
Admin users can update existing mark entries for a student-subject-exam combination
The interface displays the current date by default for daily updates
Non-admin users cannot access mark update functionality
Success and error messages provide clear feedback for mark operations

file_operations.description: Add useGetAllSubjects query hook to fetch the list of available test subjects from the backend using getAllSubjects() method. Add useEditMark mutation hook (if backend supports updating marks) or document that addMark() is used for both create and update operations.

Replace the manual subject text input with a dropdown/select component populated from useGetAllSubjects hook. Add admin role check using useGetCallerUserRole hook to conditionally render the form. Set the date field to default to today's date for daily updates. Update form validation to work with subject selection. Add clear success/error feedback messages using toast notifications.

Add role-based conditional rendering using useGetCallerUserRole hook to show the MarkForm only to admin users. Display an appropriate message for non-admin users indicating they cannot update marks. Ensure the page gracefully handles loading states while checking user role.

requirements.summary: Create an admin interface for test subject management allowing admins to add and edit subjects
acceptanceCriteria: Admin users can access a test subjects management section
Interface displays a list of all existing test subjects
Admin users can add new test subjects with validation
Admin users can edit existing test subject names
Non-admin users cannot access this interface
Changes reflect immediately in the marks recording dropdown

file_operations.description: Add useAddSubject mutation hook that calls the backend addSubject() method with proper cache invalidation for the subjects list query. Add useEditSubject mutation hook that calls the backend editSubject() method with cache invalidation. Include toast notifications for success and error states.

Create a new component that displays a list of all test subjects using useGetAllSubjects hook. Include a form to add new subjects with input validation. Add inline edit functionality for existing subjects with edit/save/cancel buttons. Implement admin-only access check using useGetCallerUserRole hook at the component level. Show loading states and empty states appropriately.

Create a new page component that renders the SubjectManagement component. Add role-based access control to redirect non-admin users or show an access denied message. Include page title and description explaining the subject management functionality.
Import SubjectsPage and add a new route for '/subjects' in the router configuration. Ensure the route is properly configured with the Route component from TanStack Router.

Add a 'Subjects' navigation menu item that links to the /subjects route. Use role-based conditional rendering with useGetCallerUserRole hook to show this menu item only to admin users. Position the menu item appropriately in the navigation between existing items.

requirements.summary: Enhance the attendance interface to support daily updates by admin users with efficient multi-student marking
acceptanceCriteria: Admin users can mark attendance for the current date
Admin users can update previously recorded attendance entries
The interface defaults to today's date for daily attendance marking
Non-admin users cannot access attendance update functionality
Attendance updates provide immediate visual feedback and confirmation

file_operations.description: Set the date input to default to today's date (new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]). Add admin role check using useGetCallerUserRole hook to conditionally render the form or disable it for non-admin users. Enhance success feedback with toast notifications. Add a note that the backend recordAttendance() method handles both new records and updates.

Add role-based conditional rendering using useGetCallerUserRole hook to show the AttendanceForm only to admin users. Display an appropriate message for non-admin users indicating they cannot update attendance. Ensure the page gracefully handles loading states while checking user role.

requirements.summary: Implement role-based UI rendering that shows or hides admin-only features based on authenticated user's role
acceptanceCriteria: Admin users see all management features including update capabilities
Non-admin users (Teacher, Staff) see read-only views without update controls
Role checks use the user profile role field already stored in the backend
Navigation and page layouts adapt based on user role
Unauthorized access attempts to admin routes redirect to appropriate pages

file_operations.description: Add useGetCallerUserRole query hook that calls the backend isCallerAdmin() method to determine if the current user has admin privileges. Configure the query with appropriate caching and refetch behavior. This hook will be used throughout the application for role-based UI rendering.

Create a custom hook that combines useInternetIdentity and useGetCallerUserRole to provide a unified authentication and authorization state. Export isAuthenticated, isAdmin, isLoading, and userProfile states. This hook simplifies role checks across components and ensures consistent authorization logic.

Create a wrapper component that checks if the user is an admin using the useAuth hook. If the user is not an admin, render an access denied message or redirect to the home page. If the user is an admin or still loading, render the children components. This component will be used to protect admin-only pages and sections.

Add role-based rendering using useAuth hook to conditionally show the 'Add Student' button only to admin users. Non-admin users should see the student list in read-only mode without the add functionality.

Use the useAuth hook to conditionally render admin-only navigation items (Subjects menu item already added in REQ-11). Add visual indicators (e.g., badges or icons) to distinguish admin users in the user profile display area of the header.
